title: The Missing Inheritance
author: Oscar Halloran
blurb: Silas Vasquez, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
